test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution mentions that any person to become the President of India has to be a citizen of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 58**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 58 of the Constitution of India lays down the qualifications for a person to be elected as the President of India.
 
• Article 58(1): Qualifications for election as President. 
 
• Article 58(2): Office of Profit Disqualification
 
• Article 58(3): Clarifications on certain offices.
